Author: Drovolon
Name: Pulsar
Description: A plugin to sync sound files. /pulsar to open config. Requires a compatible sync plugin, like Lightless.
Punchline: A plugin to sync sound files.
Changelog: Adds support for converting .scd to .ogg files in the Config tab. Useful for migrating music from a mod into local music files, if you're wanting to switch to foobar2000 or deadbeef.
TestingChangelog: Added playback queue, the ability to queue across multiple mods and/or folders, a dedicated 'On Air' switch for broadcasting, and possibly fixed an issue where Pulsar doesn't work if you run the game as admin.
